title: Native VLAN & Trunk Configuration
description: Configure the native VLAN on a trunk and understand untagged traffic.
scenario: Configure the native VLAN on a trunk and understand untagged traffic.

concepts.title: Native VLAN
concepts.body: The native VLAN carries untagged traffic on a trunk. By default it is VLAN 1. Best practice is to change it to an unused VLAN.

concepts.title: Why Change Native VLAN?
concepts.body: VLAN 1 is the default for everything. Changing the native VLAN prevents VLAN hopping attacks and accidental misconfigurations.
concepts.code:
Default native: VLAN 1 (avoid)
Secure native:   VLAN 99

concepts.title: Verifying Native VLAN
concepts.body: "show interfaces trunk" displays the native VLAN for each trunk port.
concepts.code:
SW1# show interfaces trunk
Port   Native VLAN
Gi0/1  99
